title: MultiSensor AI Holdings, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-29
summary: MultiSensor AI Holdings, Inc. received notification from Nasdaq on April 27, 2026 that the company has regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement (Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)). The compliance matter is now closed and the company is in full compliance with Nasdaq Capital Market continued listing requirements. This is a routine 8-K filing disclosing a company-specific regulatory event with no relevance to macro catalysts or market structure.
key_points: MultiSensor AI Holdings, Inc. (ticker: MSAI) is listed on Nasdaq Capital Market

The company is now in full compliance with all Nasdaq Capital Market continued listing requirements
This 8-K was signed by Robert Nadolny, CFO and Corporate Secretary
